description: A SKU is sold 30% off at ST02 only from 2026-03-09 and sells several times its usual rate there for three days, while ST01 and ST06 sell it as usual at the full price. Detection should flag a sales spike at ST02. The Analyst should find the lower price a unit and blame the local price cut, and the Ops agent should alert the merchandiser at Tier 1. A spike that leaves plenty of stock is never answered with a Reorder.
